newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD falls on U.S. phone licence delay.
newsitem.headline: KDD falls on U.S. phone licence delay.

text.p: Shares of Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) lost further ground in Wednesday's afternoon session on news that the granting of a U.S. licence to the company to provide international phone services would be delayed, brokers said.
The shares fell 180 yen to 6,920 yen at 0434 GMT.

"Some small-lot selling of the issue has been seen in reaction to the news (about the U.S licence), although it is still uncertain how the company's business might be affected by the recent development," one broker said.

Brokers also said that participants were closely watching the effect of news that long-distance phone carrier Japan Telecom Co Ltd and Telecom Japan Inc, an international call carrier, are discussing the possibility of a merger later this year.
A Japan Telecom official also said on Wednesday that the company hopes to tie up with KDD in the future.
